name: Stroopwafel
bio: Rest it on your coffee for 30 seconds. The patience is the price; the caramel is the reward.

name: Speculoos
bio: Shows up with every coffee. Nobody asked; everybody's grateful.

name: Paprika crisps
bio: Belgium's unofficial national crisp. Orange fingers are a badge of honour.

name: Pralines
bio: Eats like a gift, priced like a mortgage.

name: Cheese cubes with celery salt
bio: Bar-snack royalty. The celery salt is non-negotiable.

name: Kinder Bueno
bio: Comes in a pack of two. Nobody has ever shared the second one.

name: Snickers
bio: Officially a snack, unofficially a meal replacement during release week.

name: Cuberdon
bio: Hard shell, liquid raspberry core. A 3-day shelf life and a 0-second wait before you eat it.

name: Popcorn
bio: The meeting snack. Loud, crumbly, and you'll find pieces in your keyboard until 2031.

name: Gummy bears
bio: Five flavours, one group chat argument about which is best.

name: Salty liquorice (drop)
bio: The Dutch insist this is candy. Tastes like a dare.

name: Mint chocolate
bio: Toothpaste that went to finishing school.

name: Candy corn
bio: Made of sugar, wax and regret. Somehow still in production since 1880.

name: Raisins
bio: Grapes that gave up. Ruins every cookie that looks like chocolate chip.

name: Celery sticks
bio: Burns more calories to chew than it contains. A snack in name only.
